usage: frontier_deploy.py [-h]
                          {validate,render,preflight,plan,deploy,upgrade-runtime,build-images,smoke,verify,seed-tasks,upgrade-local-network,native-publish,native-localize-images,native-local-artifacts,gpu-smoke,apply} ...

Guarded fresh-account installer for the executable FrontierCS2 Preview
profile. The site file is deliberately non-secret. AWS CLI, Terraform, Docker,
and kubectl receive credentials through their ordinary local credential
chains.

positional arguments:
  {validate,render,preflight,plan,deploy,upgrade-runtime,build-images,smoke,verify,seed-tasks,upgrade-local-network,native-publish,native-localize-images,native-local-artifacts,gpu-smoke,apply}
    native-publish      Publish a frozen native Task on local-k8s without
                        catalog import
    native-localize-images
                        Mirror frozen native images and derive immutable local
                        versions
    native-local-artifacts
                        Publish immutable native image-localized definitions
                        and Candidate records

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
